performance.verdict: CPL efficiency is real, but zero pipeline conversion exposes an intake failure, not an ads win.

findings.text: CPL fell 34.44% to $20.83 over 7d — confirmed efficiency gain — but 87 Meta leads produced 0 GHL opportunities, so no signed-case progress.
⛔ Extension with Marwan overdue since 2026-08-31; engagement is month-to-month lapsed — all spend and build work is ungated by contract.
⛔ SMS automation and Zoho Voice access both overdue since 2026-08-31; 0 CTC calls placed in 45-day series confirms intake automation is dark.
3-day lead signal (Sep 22–24: 9+5+2=16 leads) vs prior 3 days (Sep 19–21: 6+10+7=23) shows a 30% intraweek pullback as spend also dipped to $62.94 on Sep 24.
GBP actions dropped 54.55% over 7d, with 3 consecutive zero-action days (Sep 22–24); organic signal decoupling from paid surge warrants monitoring.

suggestions.text: Fix GHL intake pipeline: 87 leads, 74 contacts, 0 opportunities — map the 13-lead drop and force opp creation on form submission.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 87 Meta leads reported but only 74 contacts captured and 0 opportunities created in the 28-day window. The action is to audit the GHL workflow: confirm instant-form webhook is firing, check for duplicate/spam filters eating 13 leads, and add an automation that creates an opportunity at contact creation. Success is confirmed when new leads appear as open opportunities within 24 hours of form submission. Resolve and verify by 2026-09-28.

suggestions.text: Watch 3-day lead trend: Sep 22–24 averaged 5.3 leads/day vs Sep 19–21's 7.7 — hold budget, recheck before any scale.
suggestions.monday_update: The last 3 days (Sep 22–24) produced 16 leads vs 23 in the prior 3 days, a 30% intraweek pullback coinciding with spend softening to $62.94 on Sep 24. No budget action is warranted yet — one soft day is not a signal. Re-check the 3-day window on 2026-09-28; if the daily average recovers above 6 leads/day, the Aug Re-Launch campaign is ready to evaluate for a step-scale.

suggestions.text: Escalate ⛔ contract extension and Zoho Voice access to Sohib/Nacer immediately — all optimisation is ungated without them.
suggestions.monday_update: The Marwan extension, SMS automation, and Zoho Voice access are all overdue since 2026-08-31 and remain unresolved. Zero CTC calls placed across the full 45-day series confirms the intake automation layer is entirely dark, which means no lead is being followed up automatically regardless of CPL performance. Sohib must chase Marwan on the contract and Joy/Andrew on Zoho Voice access this week. Success is a signed extension on file and Zoho Voice credentialed by 2026-09-30.
